_description: Representative virtual dicot root system. Biologically plausible but NOT species-calibrated. Intended for testing, visualization, and architectural contrast demonstrations. Do NOT interpret these values as calibrated parameters for any specific crop.
name: VirtualDicot
_note_biology: One radicle-derived primary root that remains dominant as a taproot. First-order laterals emerge nearly horizontally along the taproot (shallow angle). Dense short second-order hairy laterals on all first-order laterals. No seminal roots. No nodal or crown roots.

root_axis_classes._note: Documentation metadata only — not read by the simulator.

_note_order0: Single taproot. Very small axial_spread_deg for near-vertical start. Strong g_axial keeps the taproot growing straight down.
_note_order1: Laterals emerge at ~80 deg from the taproot (nearly horizontal, shallow angle as in reference image). g_axial/noise_axial apply to order-1 as well (current code limitation).
_note_order2: Dense, short hairy secondary laterals. High branching_prob_order2 and short max_tip_age_order2 produce a hairy root appearance. noise_lateral is high to give natural irregularity.
